title: Asymmetric Shapley values: incorporating causal knowledge into model-agnostic explainability
reasoning: The paper introduces Asymmetric Shapley values as a framework for model-agnostic explainability. While it applies this framework to detect unfair discrimination (social bias) in machine learning models, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethical reasoning frameworks as subjects of study, nor does it address LLMs or NLP systems.
